+title: 'ROUTER-3: includesRecorded gives the sessions on disk through ProjectRegistry, SessionIndex and facts.json'
+---
+## Goal
+With `SessionQuery.includesRecorded`, the directory also gives the sessions that are on disk and not live, so a new process finds the sessions of an earlier process.
+
+## Spec
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-router.md#router-3-session-directory ("on request, recorded sessions (on disk)"; "The directory also owns the record of past sessions")
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/session.md section 5.2 (test: "With `includesRecorded`, a new process finds the sessions on disk through `SessionIndex`")
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMultitool/session.md section 13.3 ("Recorded sessions")
+
+## What
+- New `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RecordedSessions.swift`: reads the recording roots, then `SessionIndex(root:).read()` of each root, then for each record the session directory's `session.json` (`SessionSidecar`: `workingDirectory`, `agentSpawn`, fork fields) and `facts.json` (`SessionFacts`), and gives a `SessionSummary` with `isLive == false`. Kind: `agentSpawn` gives `subagent`, a fork sidecar gives `fork`, else `root`. State: `archived` when `facts.archivedAt` is set, else `idle`. A record whose directory is gone is skipped, with a log warning.
+- **Where the roots come from:** the recording root of a project depends on the ACPAgent `transcripts.location` setting (`TranscriptLocation.recordingRoot(workingDirectory:name:userDirectory:)` and `Agent/RegisteredRecordingRoots.swift` in FoundationModelsACPAgent), which Router does not know. Plan: `RouterSessionDirectory` gets the roots from the host as plain data, with no new port type: `public func useRecordingRoots(_ roots: @escaping @Sendable () async throws -> [URL])`, and a default of the router's own `recordingsDir` layout. `ProjectRegistry` gives the project list that the host maps to roots. This needs a yes from the spec owner (see the questions in the plan reply); do not invent a `RecordedSessionCatalog` port.
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RouterSessionDirectory.swift`: `sessions(matching:)` merges live and recorded (a live entry wins over the recorded one with the same id), then filters, sorts and limits as before; `summary(of:)` falls back to the recorded summary.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: router A vends and records two sessions, router B (a new instance on the same recording root) with `includesRecorded: true` finds both with `isLive == false`; without it, finds none.
+- [ ] Add `RecordedSessions` reading index, sidecar and facts; kind and state rules as above.
+- [ ] Add `useRecordingRoots(_:)` and the merge in `sessions(matching:)` and `summary(of:)`.
+- [ ] A recorded session with `archivedAt` has state `archived`; a missing session directory is skipped with a warning.
+- [ ] A file `sessions.jsonl` written in the old ACPAgent format (the literal from the move card) gives a summary with empty facts.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A second router instance finds the sessions of the first through `SessionIndex` when `includesRecorded` is true, and only live sessions when it is false.
+- [ ] A session that is live and recorded shows once, as live.
+- [ ] Kind, parent id, working folder and facts of a recorded summary match what was written.
+- [ ] A recorded archived session has state `archived`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/RouterSessionDirectoryRecordedTests.swift`
+- [ ] `swift test --filter RouterSessionDirectoryRecorded` passes; the full `swift test` stays green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #session #recording
\ No newline at end of file

Restored roots (`.restored`), forks, subagents and memory-only sessions append nothing, so the existing in-memory directory suites write no file.

+    - Extras InMemorySessionDirectory: `summary(of:)` answers recorded sessions regardless of `includesRecorded`; the query filter is `includesRecorded || isLive`.

+    ### implementation landed
+    - New `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RecordedSessions.swift`: reads each root's `sessions.jsonl`, keeps the last record per session id, skips (warning) a record whose id is not a ULID or whose directory is gone, and builds a non-live `SessionSummary` from `session.json` + `facts.json` (kind root/subagent by `agentSpawn`, archived by `archivedAt`, title facts-then-record with empty = none, `updatedAt` = later of record and facts.json mtime).
